mapper.select: SELECT id, name, author, publish, isbn, introduction, language, price, publish_date AS publishDate, type_id AS typeId, status FROM book_info WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO book_info (name, author, publish, isbn, introduction, language, price, publish_date, type_id, status) VALUES (#{name}, #{author}, #{publish}, #{isbn}, #{introduction}, #{language}, #{price}, #{publishDate}, #{typeId}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE book_info SET name = #{name}, author = #{author}, publish = #{publish}, isbn = #{isbn}, introduction = #{introduction}, language = #{language}, price = #{price}, publish_date = #{publishDate}, type_id = #{typeId}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
